fact: The Beehive Cluster, or Praesepe, an open cluster in Cancer about 600 light-years away.
bio: Galileo resolved about 40 of its stars with his telescope, showing that it was a crowd of stars and not a nebula. NASA counts around 1,000 stars, formed from the same collapsing gas cloud and now about 600 to 700 million years old, mostly blue-white. It covers about three and a half full Moons of sky, so binoculars suit it, resolving around 20 stars. NASA lists it among the clusters closest to Earth.
